Terminal emulator
Pick the terminal app to configure.

Keys
  ↑/↓   k/j   Move cursor
  enter       Commit selection
  esc         Return to previous step (selections preserved)
  ?           Toggle this help
  q           Quit immediately

↑/↓ move   enter select   esc back   ? help   q quit
